issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal):boolean (i.e., returning boolean), but the rest of the textual specification and the solution implement addAnimal(Animal) without a return value (void). The template repository does not provide a stub with a return type, and the solution uses a void addAnimal(Animal) method. This inconsistency in the expected return type for addAnimal can confuse students about the correct signature to implement and may cause mismatches with automated tests or provided examples.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the expected signature consistent across artifacts. Two options: (A) Update the UML in problem_statement.md to show addAnimal(animal: Animal):void to match the textual description and the solution; or (B) change the solution (and template stub, if provided) so addAnimal returns boolean (e.g., boolean addAnimal(Animal a) { return animals.add(a); }). Option (A) is preferred if the intent (per textual spec) is no return value.
